name: pharn-oss
_version_comment: DELIBERATELY INERT — 0.0.0, and it stays there. The product version of record is SKILLS_VERSION (what an install receives, what the README badge shows, what CHANGELOG entries are keyed to). This package is `private: true` and is never published, so npm's version field addresses nothing. It previously read 1.0.0 as a 'foundation tag', which made a THIRD identity to keep in sync with SKILLS_VERSION and the README badge — and nothing stopped a well-meaning bump of it from passing every gate. Bump SKILLS_VERSION instead; see CLAUDE.md, 'SKILLS_VERSION discipline'.

scripts._test_glob_comment: `.claude/hooks/*` NOT `.claude/**` — the narrowing is load-bearing, not cosmetic. `**` does not descend into dot-directories, so the leading `**/*.test.mjs` never reached `.claude/`; the EXPLICIT `.claude/**` did, and it pulled a nested checkout under `.claude/worktrees/<name>/` into the run (measured: 3055 tests against 1886, the duplicates re-running another checkout's suites against that checkout's sources). Verified in a fixture holding a nested duplicate: `**/*.test.mjs` alone -> 1 test; adding `.claude/**/*.test.mjs` -> 2; adding `.claude/hooks/*.test.mjs` instead -> 2, the real hook test and NOT the duplicate. The narrowing loses nothing: every test file under `.claude/` is a hook test (`find .claude -name '*.test.*' -not -path '.claude/hooks/*'` -> 0). ADVISORY (P0): no checker reads this pattern — nothing stops it widening again. Companion to the `.claude/` closure in the capability walkers (lessons-learned L36); the named residual is `test-glob-check`.
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run lint:md && npm run docs:check && npm run check:markers && npm run check:badge && npm run check:changelog && npm run check:contributing && npm run check:reconcile && npm test
